NAKU native AirPlay2 sender

Independent Swift protocol implementation; no Unisson proprietary code copied.
Protocol reference: MIT pyatv b277a4c8222ecdcbaab8a24e3e713ca44765adb4
https://github.com/postlund/pyatv
See licenses/homepod/pyatv-LICENSE.txt.

BigInt: MIT attaswift/BigInt; vendored Sources with its original LICENSE.md.
https://github.com/attaswift/BigInt

Build/offline check:
python3 scripts/test_homepod_sender_native.py

Use -O for release or hardware timing qualification.
Probe only sends when explicitly given numeric IPv4 and duration.
Its quiet tone does not change HomePod volume.
120ms is requested receiver buffering; it is not measured acoustic latency.
